name: Get Deal Overview
description: Fetch the AI risks and objections details for the given deal, supporting dynamic severity levels (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) based on parent company risk score and close date check.

name: Get Deal Activity
description: Retrieve historical activity/engagement events belonging to the parent company associated with this deal.

name: Get Deal Briefs
description: Retrieve the generated/cached AI summary and briefs of the parent company associated with this deal.

response_example.briefContent:
**Deal Summary for Acme Expansion**

This account is performing well but has upcoming renewals.

name: Get Deal To-dos
description: Retrieve list of actionable/pending todos belonging to the parent company of the deal.

name: Toggle Deal Todo Completion
description: Mark a todo item complete or incomplete.

name: Get Deal Notes
description: Retrieve account/deal intelligence manager notes from the parent company's supplementary info.

name: Save Deal Notes
description: Update/save manager notes on the parent company's supplementary account info.

request_payload.notes: Acme is evaluating competitors. Need to schedule a follow up call.

name: Get Deal CRM
description: Retrieve CRM fields (Name, Stage, Amount, Type, Close Date) combined with parent company metadata.
